runs.diagnosis: Tree hashes and stage counters located the departure: the leaf order (Morton codes and sort) was identical and the first differing node was 164,588, late in the clustering. An independent CPU program built the tree with 12 forms of the box area; five fused multiply-add forms did not match, and the factored form dy (dx + dz) + dz dx reproduced SwiftShader's tree hash exactly (551a8446cf45792f). SwiftShader's compiler rewrites dx dy + dy dz as dy (dx + dz), an algebraic rewrite IEEE evaluation does not allow.

runs.diagnosis_p2: 2 GPU pixels were non-finite and 0 CPU pixels. Candidate causes were pow(1 - oh, 5) with a base rounded below zero (GPU pow is exp2 of log2) and sqrt(1 - p1^2) with |cos| rounded above 1. Replacing pow by a clamped product alone removed both NaNs, so pow is the inferred cause; the sqrt guard was added as well, on the CPU and the GPU.
runs.diagnosis_p4: On every failing pixel a float64 ray-triangle answer decides who is right: albedo, the path tracer matches float64 on 132 of 133 (retro_room) and 132 of 137 (iso_street), R1 on 1 and 5; depth, the path tracer on 7 of 7, R1 on 0. R1 snaps vertices to 1/256 px, which moves its UVs near texel boundaries and its depths near the horizon; the committed exemption (1e-3 texel) did not allow for that. P4 stays failed as committed; the bound is not loosened.
